providers.title: Payment gateways
providers.hint: Connect your own gateway account so your customers' payments go to your account.
providers.empty: No payment gateways are available for your company.

mode.label: Mode
mode.hint: Off takes no payments, Test tries the connection without real money, and Live takes your customers' real payments.
mode.needsKeys: To turn on Test or Live, enter all the keys and save them first.
mode.failed: The mode could not be changed
mode.liveHint: Your {gateway} account will start taking your customers' real payments.

country.label: Gateway account country
country.hint: It sets the payment currency of your gateway account.

credentials.title: Account keys
credentials.hint: Find them in your {gateway} dashboard. Keys are not shown again after saving; leave a field empty to keep its saved key.
credentials.keep: Leave empty to keep the saved key

sync.saveFirst: Save the keys first to test the connection with them.
sync.turnOn: Turn on Test or Live to test the connection.
sync.failed: The connection could not be tested

synced.title: The connection works
synced.hint: The gateway accepted the keys and the payment methods were refreshed from your account.

methodsMissing.title: The gateway account is missing some payment methods
methodsMissing.hint: The gateway accepted the keys, but your account there does not turn on a payment method LiwanOS needs. Turn it on in the gateway dashboard, then test again.

methods.label: Active payment methods
methods.empty: No payment methods are active yet.

errors.notConfigured: Enter all the keys and save them first.
errors.disabled: The gateway is off. Turn on Test or Live first.
errors.syncFailed: The gateway could not be reached or refused the keys. Check the keys and try again.
errors.methodsMissing: Your gateway account does not turn on a payment method LiwanOS needs. Turn it on in the gateway dashboard, then try again.
errors.invalid: Invalid value. Check that you copied the whole key.

pay.redirecting: Taking you to the payment page…
pay.secure: You will go to the gateway's secure payment page to complete the payment.

processing.title: Payment is being confirmed
processing.body: We received the payment request and are waiting for the gateway to confirm it. This can take a few minutes, and you can close this page.

invalidLink.title: The payment link is not valid
invalidLink.body: The link is wrong or has expired. Ask the issuer for a new link.

errors.unavailable: The payment gateway is not available now. Try again in a moment.
errors.failed: The payment could not be started. Try again.

paid.title: This invoice is paid
paid.body: Thank you. We received the payment and nothing more is needed.

notPayable.title: This invoice cannot be paid now
notPayable.body: Contact the invoice issuer to find out why.

noOptions.title: Online payment is not available for this invoice at the moment

unavailable.title: The invoice could not be loaded
unavailable.body: A temporary problem occurred. Try again in a moment.

errors.notPayable: This invoice cannot be paid now. Reload the page to see its status.
errors.inProgress: A payment of this invoice was started a moment ago on another page. Finish it there, or try again in a quarter of an hour.

paid.title: This order is paid
paid.body: Thank you. We received the payment and nothing more is needed.

notPayable.title: This order cannot be paid now
notPayable.body: The order may be cancelled or its payment time may have run out. Contact the order issuer to find out why.

noOptions.title: Online payment is not available for this order at the moment

unavailable.title: The order could not be loaded
unavailable.body: A temporary problem occurred. Try again in a moment.

errors.notPayable: This order cannot be paid now. Reload the page to see its status.
errors.inProgress: A payment of this order was started a moment ago on another page. Finish it there, or try again in a quarter of an hour.

orders.title: Online orders
orders.hint: What applies to the orders your customers pay online.

expiry.label: Time to pay an unpaid order (minutes)
expiry.hint: An order that is not paid within this time is cancelled automatically. Between {min} and {max} minutes; it applies to the current company.
expiry.invalid: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}.

invoiceWhenPaid.label: Invoice when paid
invoiceWhenPaid.hint: The order's invoice is created and posted as soon as its payment is confirmed. This choice applies to the whole account, not only to the current company.

confirming.title: Checking the payment result
confirming.body: This can take a few moments. Keep this page open.

notPaid.title: The payment was not made
notPaid.body: We did not receive a payment result. If it did not complete, you can try again.

returned.title: Payment result received
returned.body: To see the payment status, open the payment link you received again.

link.copiedHint: Send it to the customer so they can pay the invoice without an account.
link.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Copy the link by hand
link.failed: The payment link could not be created

errors.notPayable: This invoice cannot be paid by link. Make sure it is posted and has an amount due.
errors.noGateway: Switch a payment gateway to live first.
